verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents a broad API v2 covering bookings (create, recurring, instant, reschedule), slot queries, event types with custom booking fields, schedules, webhooks, conferencing apps, round-robin configuration and routing traces, and it bills itself as 'API-first'. Nothing explicitly claims or shows full UI parity, however: API keys are managed in the settings UI, the scheduling-configuration endpoint rejects non-team event types, and many UI features listed elsewhere (routing forms, workflows, payments, app-store management) have no evidenced API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or coverage matrix, API endpoints for workflows/routing-form authoring/payments/app installs/org settings, a discoverable OpenAPI spec at the probed root paths, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
